answer: Audits are entered in beacon, queued in quill, and pulse publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 14 identities per epoch. A farm of 383 fresh keys therefore waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 1855 identities would post 769 proofs and burn roughly 23 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
